story.soThat: I can import specific plugin contracts without loading unnecessary code
story.tasks:
### Create Package Directory Structure - Create packages/common/ directory - Create src/ subdirectory - Create tests/ subdirectory for future tests - Create dist/ directory in .gitignore
### Create Namespace Folders - Create src/plugin/ namespace - Create src/plugin/index.ts barrel export - Create src/plugin/interfaces.ts placeholder - Create src/plugin/types.ts placeholder - Create src/provider/ namespace - Create src/provider/index.ts barrel export - Create src/provider/types.ts placeholder - Create src/provider/validators.ts placeholder - Create src/holo/ namespace - Create src/holo/index.ts barrel export - Create src/holo/types.ts placeholder - Create src/holo/validators.ts placeholder - Create src/utils/ namespace - Create src/utils/index.ts barrel export - Create src/utils/types.ts placeholder
### Configure Package Metadata - Create package.json - Set name to "@holokai/common" - Set version to "0.1.0" - Add description field - Add author and license fields - Configure peerDependencies: { "arktype": "^2.0.0" } - Configure subpath exports - Add exports field with /plugin subpath - Add exports field with /provider subpath - Add exports field with /holo subpath - Add exports field with /utils subpath - Configure both import and types for each subpath - Configure TypeScript settings - Set main field pointing to dist/ - Set types field for TypeScript definitions - Add publishConfig with access: "public"
### Setup TypeScript Configuration - Create tsconfig.json - Extend root tsconfig.json - Set composite: true - Configure outDir: "./dist" - Configure rootDir: "./src" - Enable declaration files generation
### Verify Build and Import - Test TypeScript compilation - Run tsc to compile package - Verify dist/ directory created - Verify .d.ts files generated - Check for compilation errors - Test subpath imports - Create test script importing from @holokai/common/plugin - Verify TypeScript can resolve import - Test all four subpaths work

story-context.acceptanceCriteria:
1. **Given** monorepo foundation is established **When** I create @holokai/common package **Then** packages/common/ directory exists with src/ subdirectory
2. **And** src/ contains namespaced folders: plugin/, provider/, holo/, utils/
3. **And** each namespace has index.ts barrel export
4. **And** package.json includes subpath exports: /plugin, /provider, /holo, /utils
5. **And** package.json name is "@holokai/common"
6. **And** package.json version starts at "0.1.0" (pre-release)
7. **And** package.json has peerDependencies: arktype ^2.0.0
8. **And** TypeScript compiles successfully with composite: true
9. **And** developers can import: `from '@holokai/common/plugin'`
